notes.title: Commander Cool 2 for iPhone and iPad is now available!
notes.content:
Today we are happy to announce the long-awaited release of Commander Cool 2 for iOS. 

[h1]The best platformer on your mobile device yet. [/h1]

Commander Cool 2 is an intense time traveling classic jumper platform game
where you have to travel back into the prehistoric era to blast your way to the
future!

Get it now for your iPhone or iPad
App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id978672106?pt=998590&ct=steam&mt=8

notes.title: First Mapping Contest
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the first Commander Cool mapping contest :D
You build your own maps and we will add them to the game. The community will play and rate them. The best maps will [b]win four Commander Cool 2 steam keys[/b] to share with your friends and [b]added to the new episode pirates with your name[/b]!

1. Build your own map
Documentation: workshop.commander-cool[dot]com
Forum: http://steamcommunity.com/app/356070/discussions/1/
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=424810057

2. Send us your map
Mail to: maps[at]commander-cool[dot]com

3. We add your map to Commander Cool 2
Custom Maps (eg. Author: Headcrap, Title: Cool Map)

Questions / Problems?
Documentation: workshop.commander-cool[dot]com
Forum: http://steamcommunity.com/app/356070/discussions/1/
Mail to: maps[at]commander-cool[dot]com
My steam nick: Commander Cool

Thanks and Happy Mapping
 Commander Cool

notes.content:

Sorry but save games from older versions are lost because of the Unity3D 5.1 port. Sorry! We think about a cheat code to unlock all stone age levels.

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
We're happy to announce a new big update :) 

- Ported to Unity 5.1
- Support for more controllers
- Significantly reduced level loading times
- Disabled pause menu on level restart
- Dead players can't jump any more
- Fixed gaps between ground tiles
- Added achievements for the bosses.
- Fixe some crashes

Thanks for playing, you are awesome!

notes.title: Update 1.2!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce a new big update :)

Controls:
 - Rebinding for keyboard and controllers
 - Quick restart level (Default Select or R)
 - Switch between UI tabs on keyboard (Default 1 and 2 for left and right)

Mechanics:
 - Walljump and doublejump reworked
 - Enemies will always get knocked back on hit, depending on the force of your weapon
 
Level Selection
 - Is a fancy map now
 
Levels:
 - New tutoriallevel with cutscene!
 - Levels with fixed camera
 - Reworked most levels
 - New flying enemy
 - Reworked last boss
 - Two new bosslevels with a flying boss!
 
Bugfixes:
 - Player can no longer spawn before the map is loaded
 - Players will not switch controllers at random any more
 - Increased performance of large maps
 - Windows 32bit support
 
Common:
 - Reset save games
 - Reset leaderboards

Special Thanks to, added:
 - shieldgenerator7

[img]http://commander-cool.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/10-580x326.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development roadmap
notes.content:
Hi commanders,

first of all we want to say THANKS for your support!!!
Based on your feedback we are currently working on the following todos:
- revamp Maps (adjust the difficult, add more story elements, new objects)
- improve boss battles
- rework player control and physic (includes walljump, stucking on corners, jumping)
- custom keyboard and controller mappings
- windows 32-bit support
- better controller support (xinput)
- bug fixes

We are going to release the update this month (scheduled on 21.05.2015)

Stretch goals:
- add more stonage maps
- add new episode pirates
- revamp leaderboards
- add online coop (multiplayer)

Cheers!
 Commander Cool
